newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian film fans pay with eggs to go to cinema.
newsitem.headline: Russian film fans pay with eggs to go to cinema.

text.p: The local authorities in a small agricultural town in southern Siberia have started accepting eggs as payment for cinema tickets to get round a cash crisis, Itar-Tass news agency said on Friday.

Workers from the collective farm in Klyuchi, who like many Russian workers have not been paid for months, were now paying two eggs to watch films instead of the usual entrance fee of 800 roubles (14 cents), it said.
The system appeared to be paying off because the cinema was now full, it said. But it was a mystery what became of the eggs -- a cinema spokesman said that was a "commercial secret".
